Uptime nines

19 October 2026 2 min read
Tools

How much downtime an availability target allows.

How much downtime an availability target actually allows. Months are 30 days and years are 365, which is close enough for arguing about SLAs.

Tool
PerAllowed downtime
Day1m 26s
Week10m 5s
Month43m 12s
Year8h 45m 36s

That's 99.9537% uptime for the month.

Cheat sheet

Target Per month Per year
99% 7h 12m 3d 15h 36m
99.9% 43m 12s 8h 45m 36s
99.95% 21m 36s 4h 22m 48s
99.99% 4m 19s 52m 34s
99.999% 26s 5m 15s
